ISOLATED.definition: When one section is corrupted, all other sections remain structurally valid with non-empty narratives and PASS validation_status. Financial data hash is unchanged. Section boundaries are preserved.

RENDERED_BUT_DETECTABLE.definition: Renderer produces structurally valid HTML from corrupted IR (does not crash). The semantic corruption (reversed periods, ticker mismatch, null-to-zero, etc.) is detectable by the post-render verifier gate, not by the renderer itself.

cases.renderer_responsibility: Render each section independently from its own narrative
cases.authoritative_contract_source: report-ir.schema.json sections[] validation: each section has independent narrative + validation_status
cases.reason_old_oracle_invalid: Old oracle 'ISOLATED_FAIL' is semantically contradictory: if corruption IS isolated, expected result should be 'ISOLATED' not 'ISOLATED_FAIL'. The suffix '_FAIL' was appended to describe the corrupted section, but the test verifies OTHER sections are preserved — which they are.
cases.reason_new_oracle_valid: ISOLATED correctly describes: corruption in one section does NOT cascade to other sections. Other sections retain valid narratives and PASS status. Financial data hash unchanged.

cases.reason_old_oracle_invalid: Same as ISO-1: 'ISOLATED_FAIL' conflates the corruption (which is in the corrupted section) with the isolation result (which describes OTHER sections). When others are preserved, the correct result is 'ISOLATED'.
cases.reason_new_oracle_valid: ISOLATED: other sections preserved, data unchanged.
ISOLATED: other sections preserved, data unchanged.
ISOLATED: other sections preserved, data unchanged.
ISOLATED: other sections preserved, data unchanged.
ISOLATED: other sections preserved, data unchanged.

cases.renderer_responsibility: Renderer renders structural HTML from IR; it does NOT validate period ordering semantics
cases.post_render_gate_responsibility: Independent verifier checks period integrity via period_integrity_gate
cases.authoritative_contract_source: architecture/renderer/deterministic_renderer.py: render_html renders whatever IR is given; period_integrity_gate.py evaluates period order independently
cases.reason_old_oracle_invalid: Old oracle 'FAIL_DETECTED_BY_POST_RENDER' implies the renderer itself should detect and block the corruption. But the renderer's contract is FORMAT_RENDERING, not SEMANTIC_VALIDATION. It correctly renders whatever IR it receives.
cases.reason_new_oracle_valid: RENDERED_BUT_DETECTABLE: renderer produces valid HTML (structurally correct), and the post-render verifier gate (period_integrity_gate) detects the reversed periods. This matches the hybrid deterministic shell architecture where renderer formats and verifier validates.

cases.reason_new_oracle_valid: RENDERED_BUT_DETECTABLE: HTML produced, verifier detects mismatch.
